name: Repaint Song
description: Redraws one stretch of a song and keeps the rest as it was: a new solo, a different verse, a better ending.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: What the redrawn part should be: genre, mood, instruments, voice.

inputs.name: lyrics
inputs.label: Lyrics
inputs.description: Sung as written, with [verse] and [chorus] lines to part it. Empty: no words are given to the model, so the singing may change or go.

inputs.name: instrumental
inputs.label: Instrumental
inputs.description: No singing. The lyrics are ignored.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.label: Style reference
inputs.description: A recording whose voice and timbre the song takes. Optional.

inputs.name: start
inputs.label: From (seconds)
inputs.description: Where the part to redraw begins.

inputs.name: end
inputs.label: To (seconds)
inputs.description: Where it ends. 0: the end of the song.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.label: Quality
inputs.description: The file the model makes: mp3 (128 kb/s), mp3-320 (320 kb/s) or lossless (a 24-bit WAV, nothing lost to compression).
